claim: *What Experience Became.* The twelve governance-conversion episodes by the durable structure each failure became, coloured by enforcement class. Eight land deterministic and blocking; two stay probabilistic or advisory; two stop at measurement, one deliberately without a gate. Three up-front confirmations are excluded, keeping the conversion-versus-confirmation distinction; the exhibit restates the chapter's own narrative in structured form rather than censusing the repository independently.
topology: Quantitative axes preserve source values and categories.
bw_encoding: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction.
redesign: Restores the original twelve category bars. Three distinct gray fills preserve enforcement classes: 8 blocking, 2 advisory, 2 measurement. Exact original bucketing; three confirmations excluded. Restored external units and interpretive annotations at 10 pt.
